question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a silver ball, Bob has a red ball, and Claire has a grey ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Alice and Bob swap balls. Then, Claire and Alice swap balls. Finally, Alice and Claire swap balls. At the end of the game, Alice has the
Options:
(A) silver ball
(B) red ball
(C) grey ball
solution:
Ball colors are listed in order (Alice, Bob, Claire).
Initial: (silver, red, grey)
1. Alice and Bob swap: (red, silver, grey)
2. Claire and Alice swap: (grey, silver, red)
3. Alice and Claire swap: (red, silver, grey)
Alice has the red ball, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
